regulations.enforcement_body: City of Philadelphia Department of Licenses and Inspections
regulations.notes: Philadelphia requires STR operators to obtain a Short-Term Rental License from the Department of Licenses and Inspections. Commercial Activity Licenses (CAL) may also be required. STRs must comply with zoning and building codes. Hotel Tax must be collected and remitted. Non-owner-occupied STRs are permitted in appropriate zones.
